digest.component_or_area: review-bot event store and persistent clone management
propositions: Two untracked JSON event files exist in the persistent review-bot clone despite HEAD equalling refs/remotes/origin/tickets and no tracked diff state
The TICKET_DIGEST file is a superseded unsigned derived cache with no committed equivalent at that path; a later committed digest exists for the same ticket
The CLAIM_ENRICH file represents an expired lease with a later authoritative claim and DONE marker already committed in history
Untracked event files risk loss during history rewrites or ref resets before the A6-1 publication window
Both stranded files must be classified as duplicate or disposable before authorization to delete, and the persistent clone must reach zero untracked events with clean ref convergence
